description: Security hardening, missing endpoints (Reports, Comments), frontend auth flow polish, and production-readiness checks. Adds POST /reports, POST/GET /posts/:id/comments, rate limiting validation, Helmet headers, CORS lock-down, and verifies the full docker compose stack runs clean on 192.168.1.20. Depends on FEAT-001, FEAT-002, FEAT-003 all complete. This FEAT is independent in that it only adds new endpoints and hardens existing ones — it does not change data models.
steps: Create apps/api/src/reports/ module. reports.service.ts: create(reporterId, dto): validate targetType in ['post','comment','user'], create Report row. reports.controller.ts: POST /reports (JWT). reports.module.ts. Register in AppModule.

Create apps/api/src/comments/ module. comments.service.ts: create(postId, userId, dto): verify post exists and status='active', create Comment. findByPost(postId): return comments with user+profile, orderBy createdAt asc. comments.controller.ts: POST /posts/:id/comments (JWT), GET /posts/:id/comments (@Public()). comments.module.ts. Register in AppModule.

Harden rate limiting: in ThrottlerModule config use {ttl:60000, limit:100} for general and add a tighter guard on auth routes — create a custom @Throttle({default:{ttl:60000,limit:10}}) decorator applied to AuthController POST routes to prevent brute-force.
Add global exception filter: create apps/api/src/common/filters/http-exception.filter.ts that formats all errors as {statusCode, message, timestamp, path} — consistent error shape for the frontend.

Frontend auth flow: in apps/web/src/app/app/page.tsx add useEffect that checks localStorage for JWT, calls GET /api/auth/me to validate it. If invalid/expired: clear token, show AuthModal. Add 'Logout' button in Profile tab that clears token and redirects to /.

Frontend Create Post tab: add client-side Anti-Flex sensor mirror (same 10 phrases) for instant feedback before API call. Show character count. On 400 response from API (server-side sensor), display the error message in a red alert.
Frontend Profile tab: show mentalLevel badge, mentalXp bar (compute % within level band same as Tahap 1 logic), posts count, owned inventory items list.
Frontend Comments: add CommentSection component below each PostCard (collapsed by default, expand on click). Shows GET /posts/:id/comments results, text input + submit for POST /posts/:id/comments.

Add docker-compose healthcheck for backend service: healthcheck: test: ['CMD','wget','--quiet','--tries=1','--spider','http://localhost:3001/health'], interval:30s, timeout:10s, retries:3, start_period:40s. Add similar healthcheck for frontend: wget http://localhost:3000.

Verify .env.example covers all variables used: DATABASE_URL (constructed from DB_PASSWORD in compose), REDIS_URL (constructed), JWT_SECRET, JWT_EXPIRES_IN, DB_PASSWORD, REDIS_PASSWORD, NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL, NODE_ENV, STORAGE_PATH, THROTTLE_TTL, THROTTLE_LIMIT, FRONTEND_URL.

Final integration check: run docker compose down -v && docker compose up --build, verify all 10 tables exist with correct data after seed, verify /api/health, /api/posts, /api/avatar/items all return correctly, verify frontend loads at http://192.168.1.20 and http://192.168.1.20/app.
acceptance_criteria: POST /reports with valid JWT and body returns 201
POST /auth/login 11 times in 60s returns 429 Too Many Requests on the 11th attempt
All API responses on error return consistent {statusCode, message, timestamp, path} shape
docker compose down -v && docker compose up --build produces a fully working stack from scratch
Profile tab shows XP bar, level name, and inventory correctly
Logout clears token and redirects to landing page
verification: docker compose down -v && docker compose up --build 2>&1 | tail -20 — no fatal errors
curl -s http://192.168.1.20/api/posts — returns paginated posts JSON
cd apps/api && npm run test — all tests pass
